prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.1 °C (68% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 56.7 °C (57% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.2 °C (50% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.39 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.82 s (within 1% of healthy). Valve switching latency remains tightly within normal healthy tolerances.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.56 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 361 W·min/l (6% below healthy). Pump delivers nominal flow rate at baseline electrical input power.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.4 bar (3% below healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.
